conclusion: In this simulation with one button moved in 50 runs, replaying recorded clicks finished 4% of tasks, finding targets by simulated labels without checking finished 86% (4 silent failures), and adding a check after each action finished 94% (0 silent failures) at about 5.8x replay's time, its check catching 7 of 7 wrong clicks including popup closes.
setup: seed 1406; 50 moved runs (Save or toggle moved at random, popup p=0.3) + 10 control; 4-step task; simulated label observations from page state (no screenshots or OCR) with miss 0.06, misplace 0.04 (40 to 120 px), jitter 6 px; check misjudge 0.03; Bot B 1 retry per step; up to 2 popup closes per step; Bot B and C share code and seeds, C has no post-action checks; simulated costs ms {"click":150,"type":600,"settle":300,"observe":1300}
